note: The sickly institutional green comes from lifting GREEN in midtones and highlights while pulling red down slightly - measured input 128 -> 127,141,127, i.e. green clearly ahead of a neutral pair. Gamma lifts a little because fluorescent tubes flatten shadows. Kept gentle: green is the cast the eye forgives least, so pushing gm past about 0.12 starts to look like a broken render rather than a lighting choice.
